g.text: Terms: PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock,

retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SysML = Systems Modeling Language
